$comment: Maximal valid Proposal Mode rules object. Every declared property is exercised, including max_rounds at a non-sentinel value.

acceptance._note: criterion set to a non-default enum member so the enum is exercised, not just defaulted.

counter_proposal._note: 3 rather than 0 on purpose: 0 is the unlimited sentinel, so a positive value is what proves the bound accepts ordinary caps.

rejection._note: set explicitly rather than relying on absence.

commitment._note: the SATISFIED case of the designated_role arm.

x-com.example.gov._note: a top-level vendor-extension key (RFC-MACP-0012 §4; issue #185 S1). Its value is a JSON object the standard schema leaves opaque; this proves the x- arm accepts.
